name: Real Estate
description: ⚠⚠⚠ Two different careers share this word, and the degree belongs to the one most people are not thinking of. Florida's 8 public institutions award 408 real estate credentials — 180 bachelor's and 138 MASTER'S — in finance, investment, development and appraisal. ⚠⚠ The licence to sell houses is 63 classroom hours and needs no degree at all.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE DEGREE IS NOT THE SALES LICENCE, AND CONFUSING THEM WASTES YEARS. To work as a real estate sales associate in Florida you need a pre-licensing course that s. 475.17, F.S. caps at 63 classroom hours of 50 minutes each inclusive of examination — roughly 52 actual hours, about a week and a half — plus the state examination and a background check. No degree is required and employers report 52% accepting a high school diploma and 22% less than that. ⚠⚠ What the DEGREE prepares you for is the other half of the industry: commercial real estate finance, investment analysis, development, appraisal and portfolio management. That is a different job, with different employers, different hours and a salary rather than a commission. ⚠ 138 of Florida's 408 credentials are MASTER'S degrees, which tells you plainly which half the academic programmes serve. ⚠⚠ THE COURSE CATALOGUE SPLITS THE SAME WAY. REE1040 Real Estate Principles and Practices is carried by 5 STATE COLLEGES (Broward, Eastern Florida, Indian River, Pasco-Hernando, St Petersburg) — the practical entry. REE3043 Real Estate Principles is carried by 7 UNIVERSITIES and REE4204 Real Estate Finance by 8, all of them universities. ⚠ 77 undergraduate course numbers against 51 graduate ones in a prefix that barely exists below the 3000 level. ⚠ Largest producers: FIU 135, Florida State 88, UCF 62, Palm Beach State 58, UF 33, Valencia 32.

cips.note: Real Estate — 8 Florida public institutions and 408 credentials in 2023: 180 bachelor's, ⚠ 138 master's, 58 certificates of under twelve weeks, 22 longer certificates, 10 associate. FIU 135, Florida State 88, UCF 62, Palm Beach State 58, UF 33, Valencia 32. ⚠⚠ The master's share is the tell — these programmes serve commercial real estate finance and investment, not residential sales.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The nearest neighbour and, for the degree half of this field, effectively the same subject. Real estate finance, investment analysis and valuation are finance disciplines applied to buildings — REE4204 Real Estate Finance and REE4303 Real Estate Finance and Investment are carried at 8 and 6 universities respectively. ⚠ If the analytical side is the draw, finance is the more portable degree and is taught more widely.

⚠⚠ Where real estate development actually happens. The developer side of this industry needs to understand what a building costs and how long it takes, and construction management is where that is taught. ⚠ A genuine and underadvertised pairing for anyone interested in development rather than transactions.

⚠ The substitute most people in this industry actually hold. Real estate as a named degree exists at 8 Florida institutions; general business is far more widely taught and reaches the same commercial roles with a real estate concentration or the REE courses taken as electives.

⚠ Named for the sales half: residential real estate is a customer-acquisition business, and the agents who last are the ones who can build and keep a pipeline. ⚠⚠ Nothing in the 63-hour pre-licensing course teaches that, which is why most new licensees leave.

⚠ Named because a real estate agent is a self-employed business and most new licensees do not realise it until the first tax year. ⚠⚠ Commission income, deductible expenses and quarterly estimated tax are the practical curriculum nobody sells you.
